cohort_separation.rule: never pool these cohorts in one paired statistic

correction: Holm step-down across H1 and H2
effect_interval: movie bootstrap 95% CI for comparator-minus-method RMSE
optimizer_seed_policy: average optimizer seeds within each movie before inference
paired_test: exact two-sided sign-flip test over six movies

protocol_separation.rule: never rank methods across protocol clocks

secondary_status: all other method/horizon contrasts are descriptive or exploratory
